name: list_flags_project_connections
description:
List Flags connections for a project. role:source (default) lists projects allowed to read its flags; role:consumer lists projects whose flags it can read. Connections apply across environments within one team. Requires permission to list connections on the selected project.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{projectIdOrName}/feature-flags/connections --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

role.description: List connections where this project is the source (default) or the consumer

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
